description:
This 2024 Lincoln Navigator L Reserve combines sophisticated design with family-ready capability, finished in Blue with a V6 engine and 4WD powertrain that delivers the performance and reliability you expect from a full-size luxury SUV.

- Heated and cooled seats
- Premium leather interior
- Panoramic moonroof
- Navigation system with voice activation
- Revel audio system with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio
- Heated steering wheel
- Adaptive suspension system
- Heads-up display
- Lane departure warning
- Auto high-beam headlights
- 22-inch bright machined aluminum wheels
- Power moonroof with Vista roof design
- Rear seat entertainment controls
- Emergency communication system (911 Assist)

The Navigator L Reserve prioritizes your comfort with premium leather seating designed for long journeys, heated and cooled front seats, and heated rear seats for all passengers. The advanced climate control system features automatic temperature management with rear air conditioning, ensuring every occupant stays comfortable regardless of conditions. The panoramic moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the genuine wood trim throughout the dashboard and door panels adds a touch of refinement to the driving environment.

Technology and convenience features work seamlessly to enhance your experience. The SYNC 4 communication and entertainment system integrates your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility. Voice-activated navigation provides real-time guidance, while the Revel audio system with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio keeps you entertained. Memory settings for your seat, steering wheel, and pedals allow you to customize the driver's environment to your preferences.

- 200 Point Inspection
- Roadside Assistance
- Warranty Deductible: $100
- Transferable Warranty
- Vehicle History
- Limited Warranty: 72 Month/100,000 Mile (whichever comes first) from original in-service date
- Includes Car Rental and Trip Interruption Reimbursement, Lincoln Access Rewards 20,000 Points

The Navigator L Reserve delivers practical performance with a V6 engine and 10-speed automatic transmission, achieving 16 city MPG and 22 highway MPG. The four-wheel-drive system with adaptive suspension and speed-sensitive steering adapts to road conditions, while four-wheel independent suspension ensures a smooth, controlled ride even when carrying a full load. Traction control and electronic stability control work to maintain grip and safety in all weather conditions.

Safety remains paramount with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags throughout the cabin. The lane departure warning system alerts you if you begin to drift, while 911 Assist provides emergency communication when you need it. A backup parking camera helps maneuver this three-row SUV with confidence, and comprehensive braking systems including ABS and brake assist inspire confidence in all driving situations.

Lincoln Certified vehicles have undergone rigorous inspection and reconditioning, backed by comprehensive warranty coverage that transfers with the vehicle and includes roadside assistance, vehicle history documentation, and 20,000 Lincoln Access Rewards points for future purchases or services.

See dealer for details. Buyer to confirm equipment prior to purchase.

This 2011 Chevrolet Silverado 3500HD LTZ combines capability and refinement in a heavy-duty platform built for serious work and comfortable daily driving.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 397 hp and 765 lb-ft of torque
- Allison 1000 6-Speed Automatic transmission with tow/haul mode
- Heavy-Duty Handling/Trailering Suspension Package
- Heavy-Duty Trailering Equipment
- LTZ Plus Package with locking tailgate and EZ-Lift tailgate
- Power sunroof with express-open and Universal Home Remote
- Heated power-adjustable front bucket seats with leather trim
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear window defroster
- AM/FM stereo with navigation, CD/MP3 player, XM radio, and USB port
- Bose Premium Speaker System with 7 speakers
- Bluetooth connectivity and steering wheel audio controls
- Rear parking assist with integrated trailer brake controller
- Chrome bumpers and heated power door mirrors
- 4-wheel disc brakes with electronic locking rear differential

The diesel engine delivers the torque you need for towing and hauling while maintaining fuel efficiency on the highway. The Allison transmission with electronic grade braking provides smooth shifts and reliable control, backed by the engine block heater for reliable cold-weather starts. Four-wheel drive ensures traction in challenging conditions, whether navigating job sites or adverse weather.

The LTZ Plus Package upgrades elevate this truck beyond standard offerings. Heated leather seats, power-adjustable pedals, and the power sunroof create a commanding driving position with genuine comfort. The locking tailgate and EZ-Lift gate mechanism add security and convenience for your cargo.

Technology keeps you connected and informed. The integrated navigation system with voice prompts guides you efficiently, while XM radio provides entertainment throughout your day. Bluetooth connectivity pairs seamlessly with your phone, and the premium Bose audio system delivers quality sound that makes every drive enjoyable.

Safety and convenience features work together to protect you and enhance control. Electronic locking rear differential, exhaust brake, and integrated trailer brake controller give you commanding authority over this vehicle's capabilities. Remote vehicle starter, keyless entry, and auto-dimming mirrors bring modern convenience to your daily routine.

With just over 35,000 miles, this Silverado 3500HD represents an excellent opportunity to own a well-equipped heavy-duty truck with years of service ahead. The combination of turbodiesel power, premium amenities, and proven reliability makes this an intelligent investment for those who demand substance and comfort from their work vehicle.

This 2022 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Willys in gray delivers authentic off-road capability with practical daily-use features that make it a versatile choice for buyers seeking both adventure and reliability.

- BF Goodrich Brand Tires with 17 Black Steel Styled Wheels
- 3.6L V6 engine with 8-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD capability
- Dual Door Group with Premium Uppers, including power-heated mirrors and half doors
- Black 3-Piece Hard Top for weather protection and security
- Trailer Tow & HD Electrical Group with Class II Receiver Hitch and 700 Amp battery
- Uconnect 4 with 7 display, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with comprehensive entertainment options
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera for enhanced visibility and parking confidence
- Front and rear fog lights with delay-off headlights
- Passive Entry with Remote Keyless Entry and speed-sensitive power locks
- Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and anti-spin rear differential
- Split-folding rear seat with front bucket seats and center armrest storage
- Steering wheel-mounted audio controls and trip computer

The powertrain combines a proven 3.6L V6 engine producing strong performance with an efficient 8-speed automatic transmission. Four-wheel drive provides genuine capability on varied terrain, while the independent front and rear anti-roll bars contribute to both handling and stability. You'll see fuel economy rated at 19 city and 24 highway, helping balance performance with practical driving costs.

Interior comfort centers around cloth low-back bucket seats designed for extended driving and outdoor adventures. The Uconnect 4 infotainment system includes a 7-inch touchscreen display with smartphone integration, giving you seamless access to navigation, music, and phone functions. Eight speakers deliver quality audio whether you're using standard AM/FM, SiriusXM satellite radio, or streaming content through your device. Dual-zone air conditioning keeps passengers comfortable regardless of season.

The Willys package emphasizes off-road authenticity with trail-rated engineering and distinctive styling cues. The black 3-piece hard top provides weather protection while maintaining the iconic Jeep profile. Half doors with premium uppers allow for open-air driving when desired, and the removable design offers genuine versatility. Rock protection sill rails and the reinforced frame contribute to durability on challenging terrain.

Practical features support daily ownership and towing capability. The trailer tow and HD electrical group includes a 240-amp alternator, 700-amp battery, and 7 & 4-pin wiring harness, making this vehicle ready for hauling responsibilities. The rear backup camera provides valuable assistance during parking and low-speed maneuvers. Power windows, locks, and steering enhance daily convenience.

Safety features include dual front and front side airbags, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control. The integrated roll-over protection and occupant-sensing airbags provide comprehensive passive protection. SiriusXM Guardian emergency communication adds an extra layer of security for remote travel.

Welcome to Honda of Fort Myers! We're proud to be the largest volume Honda dealer in Fort Myers and the surrounding areas. With hundreds of new and pre-owned vehicles in stock, we truly have something for everyone! At Honda of Fort Myers, we don't just sell cars we welcome you into our family. Let us be your trusted partner for all your automotive needs. We look forward to seeing you soon!

- Power Folding Convertible Top with glass rear window and integral defogger
- 6.0L V8 SFI engine with 6-speed automatic paddle shift
- Magnetic Selective Ride Control with Tour and Sport settings
- Bose Premium 7-Speaker Sound System with DVD Navigation and GPS
- 18 x 8.5 front and 19 x 10 rear polished aluminum wheels
- Head-Up Display for convenient driver information
- Heated driver and passenger seats
- Power telescopic steering column with manual tilt
- XM Satellite Radio with ETR AM/FM stereo and 6-disc CD changer
- Universal Home Remote
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- High-Intensity Discharge Headlights with automatic functionality
- Four-wheel independent suspension with anti-roll bars
- Memory Package for personalized driver settings

This 2006 Chevrolet Corvette represents American sports car excellence in its purest form. With striking yellow exterior paint, this convertible commands attention on every road. The responsive 6.0L V8 engine delivers the performance you expect from a Corvette, while the 6-speed automatic paddle shift transmission puts control directly in your hands, allowing you to engage with the driving experience as much or as little as you prefer.

The retractable convertible top with integrated glass rear window and defogger combines open-air driving with practical weather protection. The interior features Highwear Nuance perforated leather seat trim with performance inserts, creating a premium driving environment. Heated front seats ensure comfort during cooler months, while the power-adjustable passenger seat adds convenience for all occupants.

Modern technology integrates seamlessly into this classic sports car design. The Bose Premium 7-speaker sound system paired with DVD navigation and GPS puts navigation and entertainment at your fingertips through the 6.5-inch LCD color touchscreen. XM Satellite Radio and the 6-disc CD changer with MP3 playback provide unlimited audio options. The head-up display projects vital driving information directly into your line of sight, keeping your focus on the road ahead.

The Magnetic Selective Ride Control system allows you to tailor your driving experience between Tour mode for relaxed cruising and Sport mode for more dynamic handling. Combined with four-wheel independent suspension and electronic stability control, this Corvette delivers both comfort and confidence through any driving situation. High-Intensity Discharge headlights with automatic functionality enhance visibility and safety in all conditions.

With 41,163 miles and a clean Carfax history, this locally traded vehicle has been well maintained. The fuel economy of 17 city and 27 highway MPG is competitive for a performance vehicle of this caliber. Every system has been thoroughly evaluated to ensure quality and reliability.

This Corvette is priced competitively and ready for immediate delivery. Schedule your test drive today to experience the combination of classic sports car character and modern convenience that makes this vehicle truly special.

This 2017 Hyundai Sonata Limited delivers a refined driving experience with a well-appointed interior and reliable performance that makes it an excellent choice for drivers seeking a dependable midsize sedan.

- HID Xenon Headlights with Dynamic Bending Light
- Heated and Ventilated Front Bucket Seats
- Heated Rear Seats
- 10-way power driver's seat with power lumbar support and memory function
- 8-inch touchscreen navigation system
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM satellite radio with complimentary trial
- Infinity premium audio system with 9 speakers
- Power moonroof
- Rear backup camera
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Blue Link emergency communication system
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- 17-inch aluminum alloy wheels

Powered by a 2.4-liter four-cylinder engine producing 185 horsepower, this Sonata pairs smooth acceleration with solid fuel efficiency, delivering 25 MPG in the city and 35 MPG on the highway. The six-speed automatic transmission with Shiftronic manual control provides responsive gear changes whether you're navigating city streets or cruising on the interstate.

The Limited trim showcases genuine leather seating surfaces that create an upscale atmosphere throughout the cabin. Dual-zone automatic climate control keeps front and rear passengers comfortable, while the heated front seats and heated rear seats provide welcome warmth during colder months. The memory-equipped driver's seat learns your preferred position and recalls it automatically, adding convenience to your daily commute.

Technology integration is seamless with the navigation-ready touchscreen that supports both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing you to connect your smartphone for hands-free calling and audio streaming. The premium Infinity audio system with nine speakers, including front-door-mounted units and a subwoofer amplified by an external 400-watt amplifier, delivers rich sound quality for your favorite music and podcasts.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. The four-wheel independent suspension combined with speed-sensing steering and anti-roll bars creates a composed, controlled driving experience on various road conditions. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and Electronic Stability Control provide confident stopping power and traction management.

The exterior styling reflects understated elegance with a black finish complemented by body-color bumpers, a rear spoiler, and dynamic bending headlights that adjust their beam pattern when cornering. Mud guards protect the lower panel finish, while the rear bumper applique adds a refined detail. Seventeen-inch aluminum alloy wheels balanced with all-season tires complete the polished appearance.

This Sonata Limited combines practical features with genuine luxury touches, creating a sedan that serves as a comfortable daily driver while maintaining the refinement you deserve. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the quality and capability this vehicle offers firsthand.

<p>Experience the perfect blend of power, style, and technology with the 2019 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 RST in striking Cajun Red Tintcoat, designed for drivers who demand capability and comfort.</p>

This model year marks a massive glow-up for the Prius line, trading its traditionally quirky, slow persona for a sleek, aerodynamic silhouette, sharper handling, and a massive boost in power. Because the entry-level SE trim rides on smaller, more aerodynamically efficient 17-inch wheels, it actually achieves the highest fuel efficiency and longest electric driving range of the entire 2023 Prius Prime lineup.

Key Performance & Efficiency Specs Powertrain: A 2.0-liter 4-cylinder gas engine paired with an electric motor generating a combined 220 horsepower (up from just 121 hp in the previous generation).Acceleration: Blazes from 0 to 60 mph in 6.6 seconds, making it genuinely quick off the line. All-Electric Range: Offers an EPA-estimated 44 miles of pure EV driving on a fully charged battery, allowing most drivers to complete daily commutes without using any gasoline .Fuel Economy: Delivers 52 MPG combined (50 city / 47 highway) once the electric battery is depleted. It achieves 127 MPGe when running in full hybrid/electric coordination. Battery & Charging: Features a 13.6-kWh lithium-ion battery. It recharges in roughly 11 hours on a standard 120V household outlet or around 4 hours using a 240V Level 2 charger. Standard Standard Features (SE Trim)Despite being the base model, the SE trim comes highly equipped with modern technology and comfort items: Infotainment: An 8-inch audio multimedia touchscreen featuring wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Cabin Amenities: A heated steering wheel, rain-sensing windshield wipers, 6 USB-C ports, and a unique, levitating digital gauge cluster positioned above the steering wheel line. Suite: Comes standard with Toyota Safety Sense 3.0, which includes Lane Departure Alert, Pre-Collision Braking, Proactive Driving Assist, and standard Blind Spot Monitoring with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert. Traffic Jam Assist: Allows for hands-free driving in stop-and-go traffic at speeds under 25 mph (requires an active drive connect subscription).

This 2023 Jeep Grand Cherokee L Limited in Silver combines capable four-wheel drive performance with premium comfort features designed for families who value both versatility and refinement. Climate control zones throughout the cabin ensure comfort for all passengers, while heated front and rear seats provide warmth during cooler months. The heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic temperature control further enhance the driving experience across seasons.

Technology integration makes connectivity seamless with SiriusXM satellite radio including the 360L package, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, and garage door transmitter integration. The navigation system with voice control and traffic information keeps you informed and on track. Safety features include electronic stability control, four-wheel independent suspension, and a comprehensive airbag system designed to protect your family.

Premium lighting includes auto high-beam headlights, front fog lights, and delay-off headlights for enhanced visibility and safety. The power liftgate opens hands-free for convenient loading and unloading.

description:
The Dodge Viper was conceived under then-Chrysler President Bob Lutz as a no-compromise American supercar, and the team that built it followed that mission to the letter. The V10 engine began life as a truck motor, but Lamborghini was brought in to rebuild it with an all-aluminum block and heads specifically for the Viper, producing 400 horsepower and 465 pound-feet of torque from 8.0 liters. There were no exterior door handles, no ABS, no traction control, and no airbags. The early Viper was unapologetically raw, and that is exactly what made it legendary. This 1993 example carried the Michigan plate-inspired name HISSSS, is a one-owner car, and has been built out from that already serious foundation into a dedicated track-capable machine with a TNT Motorsports package.

The TNT Motorsports upgrades are documented with the signed underside of the hood, TNT Motorsports floor mats, and physical evidence of headers, G-force components, and rumble upgrades throughout. Car and Driver articles from the era specifically discussed suspension modifications as part of the TNT package. Full documentation on the build specification is available with the car. The exhaust note and physical evidence speak to the level of work done, and new Michelin Pilot Sport PS2 tires have been fitted.

The track day setup is thorough and properly executed. An Autoform bubble hardtop and side windows give the car a proper enclosed cockpit, a five-point driver harness in red replaces the stock restraints, and a quick-release fire extinguisher is mounted and accessible. The 17 inch OZ Racing Fittipaldi three-piece racing wheels are a serious and correct choice for a car used at the circuit.

Inside, the carbon fiber glove box, dash, and steering wheel give the cabin a purposeful, race-derived feel. A metal shift grip with the Viper logo, Kenwood sound system, and owner's manual round out a car that has been thought through at every level. The removable plexiglass panels with locks are correct for a first-generation Viper and complement the Autoform hard top setup perfectly.

The first-generation Viper is the one collectors have been focused on as values across the nameplate continue to move. It is the most savage, most raw, and most honest version of the car, and a one-owner example with a documented performance package and a track day configuration this complete is not something you come across on a regular basis. Additional documentation on the TNT Motorsports build spec will be made available as it is confirmed.

Please call or email us today for more information.
